title.zh: 授权 Jesus B. Pacquing 将其特许权转让或抵押给任何政府所有或控制的金融及/或银行机构的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing Jesus B. Pacquing to Assign or Mortgage His Franchise to Any Government-Owned or Controlled Financial and/or Banking Institution
title.orig: An Act Authorizing Jesus B. Pacquing to Assign or Mortgage His Franchise to Any Government-Owned or Controlled Financial and/or Banking Institution

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5393_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, Jesus B. Pacquing is hereby authorized to assign or mortgage his franchise granted under Republic Act Numbered Forty-three hundred and forty-four, to any government-owned or controlled financial and/or banking institution: Provided, However, That the machineries and equipment used in the business are also mortgaged together with the franchise.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
